task: Draft a brief notice for first-time users of a fictional apartment building's shared tool box. Use a heading and numbered steps. Make the same-day return deadline easy to find, and distinguish returning an undamaged tool from reporting damage. Use only the supplied service rules.

facts.text: The shared tool cabinet is in the lounge.
The front desk holds the cabinet key.
A borrower records their first name and the borrowed item in the paper log.
An undamaged tool must be returned to the cabinet before the lounge closes on the day it was borrowed.
A damaged tool must be taken directly to the front desk.

forbidden_additions: A deposit, borrowing charge, or online registration requirement.
Permission to keep a tool overnight.
Instructions for residents to repair a damaged tool themselves.
preserve: The return deadline is before closing on the borrowing day.
Damage reporting goes to the front desk rather than back into the cabinet.
